headword: {落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}
reading: らくようこうようじゅ

definitions.explanation: A broadleaf tree that sheds all its leaves in autumn or winter, as opposed to an evergreen broadleaf tree. Maples and zelkova are typical examples.

examples.japanese: ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}だ。
examples.english: The maple is a representative deciduous broadleaf tree.

examples.japanese: {落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧になると⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: A deciduous broadleaf forest sheds its leaves when winter comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}→常緑広葉樹：30888_jouryokukouyouju⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混在|こんざい}→混在：13352_konzai⟧している。
examples.english: Deciduous and evergreen broadleaf trees coexist in this area.

notes:
⟦{落葉|らくよう}→落葉：17301_rakuyou⟧ (leaf-shedding) + ⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧ (broadleaf tree): a broadleaf tree that drops all its leaves seasonally, unlike an evergreen broadleaf tree. Most Japanese trees famous for autumn color, such as maples and zelkova, belong to this category.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}→常緑広葉樹：30888_jouryokukouyouju⟧: evergreen broadleaf tree — keeps its leaves year-round instead of shedding them
- ⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧: the broader category covering both deciduous and evergreen broadleaf trees
